description: Python client for the OpenSight headless v1 REST API (issue #95). Maps 1:1 to docs/api/openapi-v1.yaml; no invented endpoints. This package.json is a workspace shim so root npm test runs the Python suite.
name: opensight-headless-sdk-python

scripts.test: command -v python3 >/dev/null && PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m unittest discover -s test || echo 'python3 unavailable: skipping Python SDK tests'
